src/browser-admission-test-runtime.ts.name: Test runtime with permissions
src/browser-admission-test-runtime.ts.description: Builds a real Kehto runtime with permissions switched on, used only by the loader and frame tests.

src/browser-host-config.ts.name: Read host config
src/browser-host-config.ts.description: Reads the host config embedded in the page, prefers a fresh copy from the server, and shows the target URL in the top bar.

src/browser-host-runtime.ts.name: Drop a closed frame
src/browser-host-runtime.ts.description: Removes a closed single-frame napplet session from every registry the host keeps.

src/browser-host.ts.name: Browser host bootstrap
src/browser-host.ts.description: Starts the Paja page: builds the adapter, ShellBridge, firewall prompts and sidebar settings sections, then opens and restores napplet tabs.

src/browser-runtime-tabs.ts.name: Napplet tabs
src/browser-runtime-tabs.ts.description: Keeps one tab per loaded napplet: add, switch, close, reload, duplicate checks, share links, and saving the open tabs for next visit.

src/browser-service-registration.ts.name: Keep services in step
src/browser-service-registration.ts.description: Registers and unregisters runtime services so they match what the adapter offers before new frames are admitted.

src/theme-broadcast.ts.name: Theme broadcast
src/theme-broadcast.ts.description: Connects the theme service to the shell bridge so theme changes reach every running napplet.
